violations.why: The ISR can fire between the read and the write-back of the increment. Its reset to 0 is then overwritten by the stale value plus 1, so the update is lost.
The ISR can write 0 after the task stores rand() and before the task reads the value for the increment. The task then reads 0 instead of the value it wrote.
